summary.tldr: Requires consent from two thirds of the non-CPP provinces, representing two thirds of their population, before a province can adopt a comprehensive pension plan.
what_it_does: Requires provincial consent before regulations can be made for a province to adopt a comprehensive pension plan under the Canada Pension Plan.
Sets the consent threshold at at least two thirds of the provinces without a comprehensive pension plan, and those provinces must have at least two thirds of the total population of that group.
Brings the bill into force on the 180th day after royal assent.
summary.background: The bill amends section 3 of the Canada Pension Plan by adding a new consent rule for provincial pension plans.
